$comment: CI's component map (docs/development/ci.md, tools/scope.py). Every changed path must match a component; the stages of every matched component are selected, together with the stages in 'always'. A path that matches no component fails the scope. A change to this file, the resolver or a workflow selects every stage.

stages.lint: ruff, ruff format, pyright, actionlint and the standard-library check (gate.py --steps lint,stdlib)
stages.docs: the docs check, the privacy scan and the static catalog check (gate.py --steps docs,catalog-static)
stages.test: every CI test tier and the catalog coverage of this run, on each Python version (gate.py --steps tests,catalog)

components.name: inputs of the tests and the catalog check
